cards.notes: IN FLIGHT - owner ruled 2026-07-30 'make them editable with last-edited stamps' (Q-PL-13-1 answered, the non-default option). BUILT, apply-before-merge (migration 0050): appointment_notes gains edited_at (NULL=never edited) + last_edited_by + an in-tenant UPDATE policy (appointment_notes_tenant_update); DELETE still denied (editable, never deletable; created_at never rewritten). editAppointmentNoteAction = patients:write + the same W10-04 therapist own-patient re-check as the append path; any staff with patients:write may edit ('edit freely'), last_edited_by records who. Profile Notas thread gets a pen affordance (NotesList) + 'Editada por X · <datetime>' stamp; legacy patient_note_revisions rows stay read-only. RLS PROVEN on local (supabase db reset applied 0050 clean; 102 assertions: in-tenant UPDATE allowed, cross-tenant + DELETE denied). Unit test (therapist scope/trim/blank/reception) + e2e edit-flow (edit->stamp->survives re-read). Gates green: typecheck, lint 0-err, web unit 1424, build, journal 50/50, supabase sync. NOT in scope: the legacy backfill (pre-W12-13 rows -> editable = a separate 0051 follow-up) and converting the agenda drawer / Marcacoes popup into editable threads (they stay single-coalesced-note). Flips to shipped when Ivan applies 0050 + merges. ORIGINAL HELD CONTEXT: dispatched as 'PL-08 appointment notes thread' (renumbered PL-13; PL-08 = shipped Ativar-login #691, notes-unification = shipped W12-13 #654/#656/#657). The thread already exists: each note carries author+created, and the 'notes never reach patient PDFs/Declaracoes/portal' negative assertion is CLEAN + CI-guarded (notes-privacy.test.ts). HELD on Q-PL-13-1 (owner ruling): the shipped model is APPEND-ONLY/immutable (appointment_notes SELECT+INSERT only, an edit = a NEW appended row; no edited_at/last_edited_by). The dispatched DoD wants literal edit-in-place with last-edited stamps = ADD edited_at+last_edited_by columns + an UPDATE RLS policy (append-only EXCEPTION) + an edit path, i.e. relaxing the immutability invariant (hard rule #4 territory). Also DoD 'patient-profile Notas strictly read-only' would REMOVE a shipped composer surface. RECOMMENDATION (default): KEEP append-only, treat the newest row as the latest edit (author+created already shown), reconcile the DoD wording - no immutability change; confirm whether to remove the profile composer. The 0050 backfill (legacy appointments.notes + patient_note_revisions -> appointment_notes as note-one, idempotent/append-only) is READY to build but its column shape is coupled to this ruling, so it is BLOCKED on it. 'Nothing lost' holds at read time today (coalesce + dedup). Dispatch-note PR #707 merged (records the hold).
